entries.004e4e0d44b22dd1: Per-episode charges (small payments per 1 episode) for "Manga BANG!" and others, and sales of e-books in the purchase-model "Store"
entries.03a2cf67fd68bea0: This is a reporting segment that plans and operates the smartphone manga app "Manga BANG!," the Web version "Manga BANG Books," and the overseas manga app "MANGA BANG!," produces original manga, and operates the cross-border EC site "Fandom Tokyo," and it is the segment with the largest sales to external customers of the two reporting segments.
entries.0f898234d9e602c2: In the freemium section of "Manga BANG!", manga can basically be read free of charge, and users who pay can rent manga for 72 hours or buy it for about ¥40 to ¥100 per 1 episode. There is also a "Store" section where e-books can be bought 1 volume at a time. To differentiate its own app and layer its revenue, the company also focuses on producing original manga, and in February 2025 it launched the cross-border EC site "Fandom Tokyo". In the IT Solutions Business, Amazia Link Co., Ltd. operates SES, an SEO media and a point-earning app.
entries.0f9b0f73c90da987: Apple Inc. (52.7% of sales results for the fiscal year ended September 2025) and Google Inc. (10.4% for the same period).
entries.11926a6b534439c5: The freemium manga apps "Manga BANG!" and "Manga Tote", and the Web e-book service "Manga BANG Books"
entries.158d8d641db593cd: This covers the planning and operation of the freemium manga apps "Manga BANG!" and "Manga Tote" and the Web e-book service "Manga BANG Books," and manga production under the label "Manga BANG Comics." The overseas version "MANGA BANG!" is handled by Amazia Link Inc., and WEBTOON production by the non-consolidated subsidiary WithLinks Inc. "Manga BANG!" is free in principle and rests on 2 models: a "per-episode payment plus advertising revenue model," earning revenue from small payments for 1 episode at a time and from advertising, and a "purchase model (store)," in which e-books are bought 1 book at a time. The securities report does not state this business's sales on its own.
entries.2176f4526bfb5139: The [[term:annual-securities-report|Annual Securities Report]] states that the group consists of 4 companies in total, the company, 2 consolidated subsidiaries and 1 non-consolidated subsidiary, and operates 2 reportable segments: the Entertainment Business and the IT Solutions Business.
entries.2817dd4b398643e7: Operation of "PetWalk", an app released by Amazia Link Co., Ltd. in August 2025, in which users earn points for posting pet photos and for actions on advertisements, and can exchange the points for cash, electronic money and other items.
entries.2ccc964facff09e7: IT solutions such as SES (provision of IT personnel), SEO media, and points-earning apps.
entries.2e8c9580295404dc: Advertisers and advertising agencies (including ad networks).
entries.3620a29cf307a487: Amazia Link Co., Ltd. released and operates "LogsFix", a recruitment-related information service, in October 2024, and "Manga BANG Magazine", an entertainment-related information service, in September 2025 under a business partnership with Ranku-o Co., Ltd. Through the media sites, it delivers results such as purchases of or registrations for advertisers' products and services, and earns revenue when a result occurs. The securities report says "LogsFix" is struggling to get started.
entries.53e861fd71f8713e: Apple Inc. (52.7% of sales results for the fiscal year ended September 2025) and Google Inc. (10.4% for the same period). Both are platform operators responsible for app distribution and billing, and the securities report states that these sales results are the total amount of usage fees from users of the paid-content services that the Group provides through such companies
entries.5463d9200c5d3dc5: Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥2,843,175 thousand (down 20.7% year on year).
entries.56ef41c882907acf: This is the operation of the cross-border EC site "Fandom Tokyo," started in February 2025, which sells trading cards, figures, plastic models, pin badges, plush toys and other items to overseas customers. The securities report states that sales are small and the business is at its launch stage, and also states that monthly sales exceeded ¥10 million and the business got off to a good start. Sales of this business are not stated on their own.
entries.595b06ed6e41dfea: This business plans and operates the freemium manga apps "Manga BANG!" and "Manga Tote" and the Web e-book service "Manga BANG Books," and produces manga under the label "Manga BANG Comics."
entries.66ef32edd27f65c0: In-app advertising revenue (from displaying ads and viewing video ads).
entries.676b3d41f62f2888: Business support through the provision of IT personnel (SES)
entries.70184050556c9bdf: Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥2,843,175 thousand (down 20.7% year on year). By reportable segment, the Entertainment Business recorded ¥2,792,398 thousand (down 22.1% year on year), and the IT Solutions Business ¥50,777 thousand. The annual securities report states that both billing revenue and advertising revenue decreased, due to a decline in MAU from reduced advertising and promotion expenses and a fall in advertising revenue per unit. Because customers purchase and use coins, the company records coins as contract liabilities when they are granted, and recognizes revenue when coins are used to purchase content.
entries.74232ebf9a1ade4d: Operating loss for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥361,169 thousand (¥400,612 thousand in the previous fiscal year), ordinary loss was ¥357,578 thousand (¥403,486 thousand), and net loss attributable to owners of the parent was ¥372,270 thousand (¥589,444 thousand). Cost of sales was ¥2,267,268 thousand (down 13.6% year on year), and selling, general and administrative expenses were ¥937,076 thousand (down 31.3%), with advertising and promotion expenses kept to ¥332,238 thousand (down 56.2%). The annual securities report states that the company set this period as a period of advance investment, pursuing profit securing in the Entertainment Business and investment in the IT Solutions Business and others. Cash and cash equivalents as of September 30, 2025 were ¥460,589 thousand, down ¥467,920 thousand from the end of the previous consolidated fiscal year.
entries.78dae375d20cc7e7: “Manga BANG!” earns advertising revenue by having many users view in-app ads, while also proposing small payments at moments when users want to pay, increasing the number of paying users.
entries.7bab1c900ed76d2e: This reportable segment plans and operates the smartphone manga app "Manga BANG!," its Web version "Manga BANG Books" and the overseas manga app "MANGA BANG!," produces original manga, and operates the cross-border EC site "Fandom Tokyo"; of the 2 reportable segments, it has the largest sales to external customers. Sales for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥2,792,398 thousand (down 22.1% year on year), and segment profit was ¥5,758 thousand (segment loss of ¥54,959 thousand in the previous year). The securities report states that reduced advertising expenses lowered MAU (monthly active users) and advertising revenue per unit, so both paid-content revenue and advertising revenue decreased, while sales of "Manga BANG Comics" rose 62.8% year on year and monthly sales of the cross-border EC site "Fandom Tokyo" exceeded ¥10 million. With the start of the cross-border EC business in February 2025, the former "Manga App Business" was renamed to this name, and the cross-border EC business was consolidated into the same reportable segment.
entries.7f45c17157e43e7c: This is the operation of "Fandom Tokyo," a cross-border EC site launched in February 2025 that sells trading cards, figures, plastic models, can badges, plush toys, and other products overseas.
entries.88cce5feebddf5d6: Advertisers and advertising agencies (including ad networks). Parties entrusted with placing ads in the app’s advertising space.
entries.8fc99f7b0791a3cb: A reportable segment providing IT-related services such as SES (business support by providing IT personnel to client companies), operation of SEO media, and operation of a point-earning app, carried out mainly by Amazia Link Co., Ltd.
entries.9729ed1268af542e: Revenue based on the deployment of IT personnel in the SES Business, and performance-based fees from the SEO media.
entries.9d4e72e71f8527e5: “Manga BANG!” earns advertising revenue by having many users view in-app ads, while also proposing small payments at moments when users want to pay, increasing the number of paying users. The annual securities report states that the business is heavily dependent on two platform operators, Apple Inc. and Google Inc., and that changes in commission rates or removal of apps could affect results. In distributing electronic comics, the company has entered into copyright license agreements with numerous copyright holders and others.
entries.a8a6358307a71b52: The company is headquartered in Shibuya Ward, Tokyo, is listed on the Growth Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange, and was established in October 2009.
entries.a9772ad489b7a384: Sales of products on the cross-border EC site "Fandom Tokyo"
entries.aea04710a155d6f8: The "Wizumai Medical Online Clinic" operated by the consolidated subsidiary Wizumai Medical Co., Ltd. The securities report says that, as standards for medical-related advertising became stricter, expanding the business was judged to be difficult, and the service was ended in November 2025.
entries.b74f5f977b8045a0: A reportable segment providing IT-related services such as SES (business support by providing IT personnel to client companies), operation of SEO media, and operation of a point-earning app, carried out mainly by Amazia Link Co., Ltd. The business started in the fiscal year ended September 2024, and the securities report says the sales amount is small and the business is at the launch stage. For the fiscal year ended September 2025, sales were ¥50,777 thousand (segment sales of ¥550 thousand in the previous year) and the segment loss was ¥45,551 thousand (segment loss of ¥16,393 thousand in the previous year). The report says that in the SES business, personnel costs increased as hiring of personnel was actively pursued, but sales grew steadily.
entries.b85389e3741083d2: Operation of "PetWalk", an app released by Amazia Link Co., Ltd. in August 2025, in which users earn points for posting pet photos and for actions on advertisements, and can exchange the points for cash, electronic money and other items. Points are granted using part of the advertising fees the Group receives from advertisers, and the securities report says preparations are under way to expand the number of users.
entries.bf6fe29ec063ce10: Amazia Link Co., Ltd. released and operates "LogsFix", a recruitment-related information service, in October 2024, and "Manga BANG Magazine", an entertainment-related information service, in September 2025 under a business partnership with Ranku-o Co., Ltd.
entries.c026d6e8134e93e6: Operating loss for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥361,169 thousand (¥400,612 thousand in the previous fiscal year), ordinary loss was ¥357,578 thousand (¥403,486 thousand), and net loss attributable to owners of the parent was ¥372,270 thousand (¥589,444 thousand).
entries.c401476a6383bf8e: Apple Inc. and Google Inc. (platform operators responsible for app distribution and payment processing; accounted for 52.7% and 10.4% of sales in the fiscal year ended September 2025).
entries.c4d4c4f76626bab1: Production of original manga and WEBTOONs (label: “Manga BANG Comics”).
entries.ca66e1d1427a3bc2: A company that provides the manga app "Manga BANG!" free of charge in its basic form and earns revenue from small in-app payments by readers and from advertising.
entries.cb7d89e664f7a7eb: The company is headquartered in Shibuya Ward, Tokyo, is listed on the Growth Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange, and was established in October 2009. It consists of four companies in total: the company, two consolidated subsidiaries (Amazia Link Inc. and Wizumai Medical Co., Ltd.), and one non-consolidated subsidiary (WithLinks Co., Ltd.); as of September 30, 2025, consolidated employees numbered 53 (average annual number of temporary employees: 16), a small organization. Founder Ryosuke Sakuma serves as representative director and president.
entries.cc12ce07706bd831: A basically free manga app, and manga production and new businesses.

entries.ea34e003e76633ca: The [[term:annual-securities-report|securities report]] states that the Group, made up of the company, 2 consolidated subsidiaries and 1 non-consolidated subsidiary, 4 companies in total, operates 2 reportable segments: the Entertainment Business and the IT Solutions Business. The main business is the freemium manga app "Manga BANG!", which can be read free of charge in principle and earns revenue from small per-1-episode payments and in-app advertising. The company is also developing new businesses such as manga production, a cross-border EC site and the provision of IT personnel. For the fiscal year ended September 2025, revenue was ¥2,843,175 thousand (down 20.7% year on year) and operating loss was ¥361,169 thousand.
